shortDescription: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake struck New Guinea, Papua New Guinea, on Sunday, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre said.The quake, which was originally given as 5.9 magnitude before being revised down, was at a depth of 10 km (6 miles), EMSC added.
